description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two text-to-SQL generation models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories in order from left to right. For each category, there are two grouped bars: a light gray bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, with their respective accuracy values labeled above each bar. In the Simple category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21 and TA-SQL has 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. For the Challenging category, NatSQL achieves 32.32 and TA-SQL achieves 36.11. The Total accuracy is shown for both models, with NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories listed on the horizontal axis. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the value labels on top of each bar.
